title: Point a Post or Page to another website
body: In the Post or Page settings, choose Point this content to, then A custom URL. Readers follow that address from Home, listings and search. Links open in a new tab by default. You can publish up to 500 linked Posts and 500 linked Pages at once. A shared 1 MB limit also applies to linked addresses. If Boardwalk asks, shorten a URL or switch an item back. Switch back to the normal NJ PBS address whenever you need; your body stays saved.
